concepts.title: Obsidian
concepts.logline: Darkness, metal and water: the bottle is discovered one hard edge of light at a time until it stands whole on wet rock.
concepts.insight: Real confidence is quiet; it shows in details, not noise.
concepts.device_image: The round of a falling water drop cuts to the round of the cap, the same size in frame.

hook.image: A razor line of light crawling over a brushed metal cap
hook.question: What is hiding in the dark?

product_role.line: Every shot is a detail of the bottle; the montage is the bottle revealing itself.

concepts.cultural_meaning: Restraint and attention to detail, read as status in the Gulf.
concepts.originality_claim: No splash, no smoke: light and water discover a still object.
concepts.differentiator: Pure material and light; no story, no character until one hand at the end.

concepts.title: Night Rain
concepts.logline: Rain on a midnight terrace beads on cold glass while the city hum fades; one drop at a time builds to the scent.
concepts.insight: The best nights start in the quiet minutes before you leave.
concepts.device_image: The rain stops in mid-air around the bottle while one drop keeps running down the glass.

hook.image: A single raindrop landing on a leaf in extreme slow motion
hook.sound: rain on glass and a fading city hum
hook.question: What is the night waiting for?

product_role.line: The bottle sits in the calm before the night, ready.

concepts.cultural_meaning: The late, quiet start of a Gulf evening.
concepts.originality_claim: Weather and silence instead of party clichés.
concepts.differentiator: Built around weather and the city at night instead of pure material.

concepts.title: Desert Ember
concepts.logline: Wind-carved sandstone and the last ember of a majlis fire glow behind the bottle as heat shimmers past it.
concepts.insight: Heritage is warm; it is carried, not displayed.
concepts.device_image: The heat shimmer over the sandstone tightens, thickens, then condenses into the bottle.

hook.image: An ember's glow sweeping over carved sandstone
hook.sound: the crackle of a dying ember
hook.question: Whose fire was this?

product_role.line: The bottle carries the warmth of the majlis fire.

concepts.cultural_meaning: Fire and scent as the carriers of family memory.
concepts.originality_claim: Heritage shown as warmth, not as museum props.
concepts.differentiator: Warm desert palette and heritage materials instead of cold water and metal.
